Container.Name: Qobuz Curator
Container.Overview: Turn music recommendations into reviewed Qobuz playlists from a private, local-first web application.
Container.Description: Qobuz Curator imports written or structured music recommendations, matches recordings against Qobuz, previews changes, and performs verified playlist writes. Configuration and SQLite state remain in appdata. On first start, the container creates its configuration from the supplied QOBUZ_CURATOR_* environment values.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent configuration, SQLite database, and backups.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Host port for the Qobuz Curator web interface.

Config.Name: Provider
Config.Description: Use fake for initial evaluation or qobuz after supplying Qobuz credentials.

Config.Name: Qobuz User Token
Config.Description: Qobuz user authentication token. Stored in appdata when the initial configuration is created.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional OpenAI API key for in-app recommendations. Stored in appdata when the initial configuration is created.

Config.Name: Authentication Disabled
Config.Description: Disable application login. Keep the Web UI private when enabled.

Config.Name: Password Hash
Config.Description: Password hash generated with qobuz-curator password-hash when authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Optional 32+ character secret. A random value is generated in appdata when omitted.

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated external DNS names or IP addresses accepted by the Web UI.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Enable only when every browser connection uses HTTPS.
